title: AfterLibs
description: A library mod for AfterlifeEntombed and other upcoming projects
body:
A library mod for AfterlifeEntombed and others, coming soon.

Making a mod for a bunch of different mythologies, this will be the library for them.

What does this mod do?
This mod adds utility features to minecraft that are utilized by the afterlifeentombed mod. These features include a particle framework that uses AAA particles and architectury to display effekseer particles. It also includes a logger function and several other development utilities for the afformentioned dependent mod.

Why shoud/would I download this?
If you want to play with the latest version of Afterlife Entombed, you NEED this mod. Afterlife Entombed will not function without it after version 1.1.6(of afterlife entombed). In addition, more afterlife mods will be coming in the future, and all will require this mod to function.

Cheers, and enjoy :).
